**Apple's FY2024 gross margin was $180,683 million** (approximately $180.7 billion), for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended September 28, 2024: Total net sales: $391,035 / Cost of sales: $210,352 / Gross margin: $180,683"].

Supporting context:
- This represents an increase of $11,535 million (about 6.8%) over the prior-year comparative gross margin of $169,148 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 (prior-year comparative): Total net sales: $383,285 / Cost of sales: $214,137 / Gross margin: $169,148"].
- Gross margin percentage improved to approximately 46.2% of net sales in FY2024 from approximately 44.1% in FY2023, driven by both higher net sales ($391,035 million vs. $383,285 million) and lower cost of sales ($210,352 million vs. $214,137 million) [DOC-1].

Comparability note: FY2024 was a 52-week year ended September 28, 2024, while FY2023 ended September 30, 2023; the fiscal period lengths may differ slightly, which modestly affects the year-over-year comparison. Both figures are drawn from the same 10-K on a consistent consolidated basis, so no restatement or segment-definition issue applies.

ANSWER: $180,683 million
